purpose: held-out exemption check: written after round 1, not used to tune the wording
mechanism: apply_routes() truncates the live routes file and only then validates and writes the routes one at a time, so an invalid route part-way leaves the file with the routes before it and no copy of the previous ones.
why_unseen: The finding was an installed tool replaced by a directory delete and file copy; this is a mail-routing configuration file truncated in place while its replacement is still being validated, and the exempt control is a derived sender lookup file (also rewritten in place) that holds nothing its routes source does not hold and is rebuilt on demand when it is missing or incomplete.
